title: Rewrite docs/planning/testing-quick-reference.md — it teaches the banned mockito pattern and cites nonexistent files
why: coding-standards.md TQ-4 bans new mockito; the live suite has 0 mockito imports and 182 mocktail-based test files, so every worked example in this doc uses the disallowed framework. It is dated 2026-02-08 with no staleness marker and is linked from docs/index.md's 'Planning and design' section (described there as reflecting 'the current code'). None of the concrete files it cites (curriculum_card.dart, mishnayos_adapter.dart, the adapters/ directory) exist in lib/, and its 'API Tests (Sefaria)' section describes a runtime HTTP-fetch content architecture that contradicts the actual build-time-bundled content design confirmed in docs/qa/legacy/07-content-browsing.md (FR6). A contributor or AI agent following this doc would reintroduce a banned test framework and reference dead paths.
recommendation: Rewrite against current mocktail-based test helpers and real file paths, or replace with a pointer to the current testing guide plus a superseded banner in the meantime.
acceptance_criteria: The doc contains zero `package:mockito` code examples.
Every **File:** path cited resolves to a real file under lib/ or test/.
